auto_wrap_module_tree: auto wrap PyTorch nn.Module tree with FSDP policy, ignored modules, and mixed precision settings
check_nested_wrapping: check that no submodule already has FSDP applied before auto wrapping a root module
validate_frozen_params: validate that modules to wrap contain uniformly frozen or non-frozen parameters
get_post_order_named_modules: get named modules in post-order traversal for reverse topological sorting
get_managed_param_to_fqn: map managed parameters to their fully qualified names for a module subtree
